title: Al-Muwatta
author: malik-ibn-anas
attributionNote: The compiler selected, arranged and in places commented on the reports; the reports themselves are attributed within each text to their transmitters. The catalogue distinguishes the compiler's work from the material compiled.
description: Malik ibn Anas's arrangement of the practice of Medina by legal topic: prayer, alms, fasting, pilgrimage, marriage, trade, inheritance and the penalties. It combines reports attributed to the Prophet with the practice of the city, and is the earliest surviving compendium of Islamic law.
historicalContext: Compiled in Medina in the eighth century, before the classical legal schools had taken shape. It is the foundation of the Maliki school and is received as a hadith collection by others.
availabilityNote: Streamed section by section from the Hadith API at read time, Arabic beside the English translation. The host does not identify the translator of this English text. Rights are unverified; the text is streamed with attribution to the host and is not relicensed.
